entities.summary: Indrajayavarman or Indravarman IV and also known as Srindrajayavarman was the ruler of Khmer empire from 1308-1327, and was succeeded by Jayavarmadiparamesvara. Charles Higham states this is the last Sanskrit record of Angkor.
